title: Radionuclide identification from open-access gamma-ray spectra: classical peak matching vs. machine learning (data, code and models)
description: Data, code, trained models and figures supporting the article 'Classical Peak Matching Versus Machine Learning for Radionuclide Identification Using Open-Access Gamma-Ray Spectra: A Reproducible Feasibility Study' (submitted to Atom Indonesia). Inputs: 36 measured spectra from the OpenGammaProject Gamma-Spectrum-Database and reference lines from the GSD and the INL Gamma-Ray Spectrum Catalog.
